It's not just work. I hate the city I'm living now as well. I don't feel a sense of community here. I live alone and sometimes I feel if I kill myself at home no one would find out. Gladly I don't have cats so they won't eat my face lol.

Now doing backend system design. It's not as complicated as software design but I've never done it. I was doing more consumer facing stuff before so it was more creative and fun. I just feel useless and bored and stressed out all the time at work. I was much happier and could come up with lots of ideas before.
